summary: Recover never-offered polling mail from the preceding seven days, capped at five oldest backlog messages per recipient and boot session

replay.detail: Native polling now uses the stream recovery age predicate: original sends within seven days are eligible, and mail more than one hour before the consumer's boot/session floor consumes one of five backlog slots. Pages and filtered reads share an in-memory per-recipient budget. Previously staged, delivered and uncertain attempts remain held; existing delivery holds, fences and receipts are unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema or stored-format changes; budgets are daemon-local.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No wire changes. Polling and native streams now share the seven-day recovery window and five-message backlog cap.

recovery.detail: Rollback restores polling's one-hour pre-boot cutoff. Existing receipt and native-attempt history remains authoritative; already staged mail is not replayed.
